zh: 一月份海滩会变得非常拥挤。
en: The beach gets really {crowded|busy|packed} in January.

zh: 他们住在南岛一个偏远的地方。
en: They live in a {remote|isolated} part of the South Island.

zh: 我们走沿海那条风景优美的路线吧。
en: Let's take the {scenic} route along the coast.

zh: 我们的航班延误了两个小时。
en: Our flight is {delayed|late} by two hours.

zh: 奥克兰到东京有直飞航班吗？
en: Is there a {direct|nonstop|non-stop} flight from Auckland to Tokyo?

zh: 你的护照有效期必须至少还有六个月。
en: Your passport must be {valid} for at least six months.

zh: 下飞机三天了，我还在倒时差。
en: Three days after the flight, I'm still {jet-lagged|jetlagged}.

zh: 我们在夜市尝了当地的食物。
en: We tried the {local} food at a night market.

zh: 火车上几乎是空的，我们独占了一整节车厢。
en: The train was almost {empty}, so we had a whole carriage to ourselves.

zh: 这趟航班很颠簸，气流很多。
en: The flight was {bumpy|rough}; there was a lot of turbulence.

zh: 山顶的景色美得惊人。
en: The view from the top was {stunning|breathtaking|spectacular|amazing|gorgeous|incredible|beautiful}.

zh: 在外国开车很难。
en: It's hard to drive in a {foreign} country.

zh: 皇后镇很美，但游客太多、太商业化了。
en: Queenstown is beautiful but very {touristy}.

zh: 酒店的位置非常方便，离车站只有两分钟。
en: The hotel's location is really {convenient|handy}; it's two minutes from the station.

zh: 我们在去酒店的路上迷路了。
en: We got {lost} on the way to the hotel.

zh: 我们的房间很宽敞，还能看到海港。
en: Our room was {spacious|roomy|big|large|huge}, with a view of the harbour.

zh: 这里真宁静，一点车声都听不到。
en: It's so {peaceful|quiet|calm|tranquil} out here; you can't hear any traffic.

zh: 我只订了单程票，因为还不知道什么时候回来。
en: I only booked a {one-way|single} ticket because I don't know when I'm coming back.

zh: 新加坡一年到头又热又潮湿。
en: Singapore is hot and {humid|muggy|sticky} all year.

zh: 酒店离海滩比地图上看起来更远。
en: The hotel was {further|farther} from the beach than it looked on the map.
